# bc-tdd relationships

## Outgoing

- hands off to `bc-diagnosing-bugs` — required, when bugs without a tight repro.
  Diagnosis belongs to bc-diagnosing-bugs before the regression-test RED/GREEN cycle.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md)

- depends on `bc-domain-modeling`'s contract — required, when glossary discovery in legacy projects.
  Legacy glossary discovery and rename proposals have one home in bc-domain-modeling.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md)

- depends on `bc-pipeline-to-done`'s contract — required, when recording property fail-first evidence inside a drain.
  Mutation evidence goes in the drain’s existing validation.json, not a new evidence file.
  Source: [body/properties.md](body/properties.md#fail-first-for-properties)

- depends on `bc-plan-to-pipeline`'s contract — optional, when a work item's Dependencies line says to manage without the property library.
  A `Dependencies:` line marked as the owner's answer, the form bc-plan-to-pipeline writes when the owner answered, counts as quoting the owner for skipping the property library; an unmarked line does not.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md#test-levels)

- loads `bc-safe-runs` — required, when running tests, making scratch folders, full suites, worktrees, workers or worktree removal.
  Storage-safe run and worktree-removal rules have one home in bc-safe-runs (derived from the agent kernel's Storage safety); the body keeps a one-line fallback for when the skill is not installed, which a change to the module's rules must update.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md)

## Incoming

- incoming from [agent-kernel](../agent-kernel/RELATIONSHIPS.md): loads this concept — required, when new tests or behaviour-changing assertions.
  Test evidence requires a watched behavioural fail; mechanical test edits are excluded.
  Source: [agent-kernel/body/AGENT-KERNEL.md](../agent-kernel/body/AGENT-KERNEL.md#verification)

- incoming from [bc-code-review](../bc-code-review/RELATIONSHIPS.md): depends on this concept's contract — required, when Spec review of property-based tests, the Test levels block, or a Level 3 proof.
  Spec checks properties against tdd’s Level 2 rules (weakening or deleting one without owner approval is Critical), audits the Test levels block against the diff, and treats a Level 3 escape hatch outside formal.md’s approved assumptions as Critical.
  Source: [bc-code-review/body/SKILL.md](../bc-code-review/body/SKILL.md#2-review-independently)

- incoming from [bc-code-review](../bc-code-review/RELATIONSHIPS.md): depends on this concept's contract — required, when Standards review of new or changed tests.
  Standards uses tdd’s tests-that-lie definitions to assess behavioral coverage, and checks new test files against tdd’s Test layout norms.
  Source: [bc-code-review/body/SKILL.md](../bc-code-review/body/SKILL.md#2-review-independently)

- incoming from [bc-code-review](../bc-code-review/RELATIONSHIPS.md): loads this concept — required, when reviewing tests, the Test levels block or a Level 3 proof.
  Spec and Standards review apply tdd's Test levels, Tests that lie, Test layout and formal.md; the body names the skill instead of linking into its folder.
  Source: [bc-code-review/body/SKILL.md](../bc-code-review/body/SKILL.md#2-review-independently)

- incoming from [bc-find-bugs](../bc-find-bugs/RELATIONSHIPS.md): adapts this concept — required, when every reproduction.

- incoming from [bc-pipeline-to-done](../bc-pipeline-to-done/RELATIONSHIPS.md): depends on this concept's contract — required, when deterministic pre-review gate.

- incoming from [bc-pipeline-to-done](../bc-pipeline-to-done/RELATIONSHIPS.md): loads this concept — required, when feature/enhancement work.
